hanley1973_table.title: The Viscosity and Thermal Conductivity Coefficients of Dilute Nitrogen and Oxygen
hanley1973_table.source_claimed_conductivity_uncertainty: 3 percent below 400 K, 5 percent above 400 K; high-temperature experimental data explicitly considered unreliable. These are theoretical table values, not independent measurements.

scope: Historical numeric comparison only. Values above 310 K are outside the Roder1982 measurement range; the underlying theoretical table extends further. No assertion of exact REFPROP7.0 implementation, no new production O2 property and no change to prior simulations.
